simple.meaning: אַרְכְּוַי (ʼArkᵉvay) is a Hebrew word meaning “an Arkevite (collectively) or native of Erek.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: אַרְכְּוַי (H756) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Ezra 4:9, with occurrences in Ezra.

simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in אַרְכְּוַי (H756) before moving outward to related references.

definitions.full: H756. Arkevaye אַרְכְּוָיֵ֯ proper name, of a people people of Erech (Biblical Hebrew אֶרֶךְ ; so also Mey EJud. 40 ); — plural emphatic Ezra 4:9 (Qr אַרְכְּוָיֵא ; compare K § 61, 6 ).
